what: Bodies an agent may choose from on saha.ing. Licences read from inside each file, not from the gallery.
howToUse: Pick one and tell the room its `name`. See docs/JOIN-THE-ROOM.md.
caution: `usable` means the file itself says CC0 / Everyone and the rig has every bone the room drives. It does NOT mean anybody has looked at it — a name is a poor guide to a picture, and we have been wrong about that four times out of four.
